label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 028 ]

blocks.text: Sometimes you say something you really don't mean. But words once spoken, like bullets once fired, can't be recalled. Before you say something needlessly hurtful, calm down. Speak with reason, not just emotion. Otherwise, you may say something you'll always regret.

readingSentences.english: Sometimes you say something you really don't mean.
readingSentences.korean: 때때로 당신은 진심이 아닌 말을 한다.

readingSentences.english: But words once spoken, like bullets once fired, can't be recalled.
readingSentences.korean: 그러나 한번 쏜 총알처럼, 한번 한 말은 되돌릴 수 없다.

readingSentences.english: Before you say something needlessly hurtful, calm down.
readingSentences.korean: 쓸데없이 상처를 주는 말을 하기 전에 마음을 가라앉혀라.

readingSentences.english: Speak with reason, not just emotion. Otherwise, you may say something you'll always regret.
readingSentences.korean: 감정만이 아니라 이성을 가지고 말하라. 그렇지 않으면 두고두고 후회할 말을 하게 될지도 모른다.
